corrections.category: Provider-facing metadata exposed internal case identity.
corrections.resolution: Fresh opaque materialized identities; original author files retained byte-for-byte and all30 rechecked.

exact_overlap_audit.comparison: Two archived latest local/cloud development reports, inspected privately after expected sets were independently derived.
exact_overlap_audit.limit: No semantic-near-duplicate, independent physical-regime, distribution or cross-unit generalization conclusion.
exact_overlap_audit.normalization: Exclude provenance, observation wall time and opaque identifiers; normalize simulation origins and equivalent numeric spellings; retain process values/qualities, period, sample count, alarms, units and coverage.

exposure.author: Original author implementation exposure is retained in author capsule; labels were authored explicitly, not computed with production eligibility.
exposure.reviewer_now: All private holdout content and two archived development report inputs. Reviewer is now exposed and must not tune agent/policy from these cases.
exposure.reviewer_prior: Implemented accounting, inspected production engine/provider/contracts and development tests, inherited development summaries. Not implementation-blind.
exposure.root_tuning_role: Received aggregate findings, counts, broad methodology, correction category and hashes only, with no observations, case identifiers, expected sets or per-case diagnoses.

controls.always_refuse: Must score 0/24 useful and 6/6 correct guards. A guard pass is never useful task completion.
controls.deterministic_baseline: Must match independently authored labels on 24/24 usable and 6/6 guards. Any mismatch invalidates comparison, requires private investigation and an explicit new freeze.

exposure_policy: Only isolated author, reviewer and evaluator roles may access private inputs, labels and case-level traces.
Root/tuning receives only aggregate metrics, path/interface, counts, broad families, methodology/exposure and file hashes.
Reviewer is exposed to this holdout and cannot subsequently tune prompts or policy using its content while claiming that holdout is unexposed.
Any tuning-role exposure to case inputs, expected sets or per-case diagnoses retires the package from unexposed-holdout use for that role.
Threshold changes, label fixes or source changes require new preregistration/freeze with historical records retained; no retroactive rescue.

primary.meaning: Strict synthetic policy/contract regression gate only; not plant readiness or an added-value claim.

run_integrity: Verify reviewed-manifest SHA256 and every covered file before each evaluation campaign.
Freeze provider identity/settings, prompt bytes/hash, code revision/hash and requested number of complete runs before opening private cases to evaluator.
Use exactly one initial attempt per frozen case for the primary run; no selective reruns, repairs, retry-with-answer or post-hoc case removal.
If repeated runs are preregistered, retain first-run primary results and report every complete repeat separately; do not select the best run.
A complete primary report has all 30 fixed case denominators. Infrastructure aborts require an incomplete status, never a passing score.
Record immutable private case order and full private inputs/outputs; guard clock checks use the materialization clock.
Materialize fresh immediately per attempt, preserve frozen simulation values, and do not renew an observation to rescue a stale response.
No evidence of labels/rationale/family/case identifiers enters model messages, source metadata or tool resources.

diagnostic_only: Per-item coverage, extras, missing IDs and candidate shape faults retain original release outcome.
Wall latency distributions separate usable, withheld and guard attempts; no speed acceptance threshold selected.
Provider-side faults, parse faults, timeout, stale-during-run, abstention and budget exhaustion remain failed usable attempts.

evidence_fidelity_of_released_advice.denominator: All released usable advisories; zero releases is undefined and cannot pass.

limits: Separate-agent policy-consistency review, not independent process truth or controls-engineer validation.
Not physically validated simulator trajectories, plant trials, readiness, certification or a general model-capability score.
Single known unit/profile; no cross-unit generalization or semantic independence established.
Small authored set with unmeasured population/rare-event coverage.
Local hash freeze is not external attestation.
No model or baseline evaluated on the holdout; all capability claims remain deferred.
methodology: Inspected all private observations, explicit expected sets, rationales and standalone materializer.
Independently reconstructed described policy using a private stdlib Decimal rule implementation; no production eligibility/Baseline or author label checker used.
Separately reconstructed input contract checks from schema code; verified all intended guards and usable inputs at a shared clock.

Checked fresh identities/timestamps, faithful retained process values and guards, absence of private identifiers/families/rationales/expected IDs in provider-facing JSON, and exclusive CLI output creation.
Verified original and revised author hashes and frozen final review package before any holdout agent/model evaluation.
reviewer_role: Separate reviewer agent /root/accounting; author was /root/holdout_author. Same team/model ancestry; not controls engineer or wholly blinded reviewer.
